name: Marozi
body:
MAROZI
CR 1/2

This hunting cat is sleek and spotted like a small leopard, with a long tail, a short ruff-like mane around its neck, and jutting whiskers.

XP 200
N Small animal
Init +2; Senses low-light vision, scent; Perception +5

DEFENSE

AC 14, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+2 Dex, +1 natural, +1 size)
hp 13 (2d8+4)
Fort +5, Ref +5, Will +1

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft., climb 10 ft.
Melee bite +3 (1d3), 2 claws +3 (1d3+1)
Special Attacks ambush, pounce

STATISTICS

Str 12, Dex 15, Con 14, Int 2, Wis 12, Cha 6
Base Atk +1; CMB +1; CMD 13 (17 vs. trip)
Feats Athletic, Skill Focus (Stealth), Weapon Finesse B
Skills Acrobatics +10, Climb +10, Perception +5, Stealth +13 (+17 in jungles), Swim +2; Racial Modifiers +4 Acrobatics, +4 Perception, +4 Stealth in jungles

ECOLOGY

Leaper (Ex)

A marozi is always considered to have a running start when making Acrobatics checks to jump.

Savage Leap (Ex)

If the marozi jumps at least 10 feet, at the end of its jump it can make both a claw attack and bite attack against the same target. Its movement ends after attacking.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests
Organization solitary or pair
Treasure none

These hunting cats are nocturnal predators that are more comfortable on the ground than in the trees, though they can climb well enough when necessary. They are excellent leapers and hunt near streams and water sources, springing from vegetation. Marozis are typically 1-1/2 feet tall and weigh 30-40 pounds.
